_comment: Hand-adjudicated identity resolution, decided by reading the grant
descriptions rather than by matching strings. Every decision records why.
'merge' means the rows are the same person's separate grants.
'joint' means one grant was made to several people who each have rows of
their own. A joint grant is listed under each of them and does NOT merge
'uncertain' looks like one person but the evidence does not settle it, so
the rows stay separate and the doubt is shown on the site.

joint.why: Cohort 28 is a joint grant to Anup Malani and Michael Sonnenschein, described as repeat winners collaborating.
Cohort 46 free speech work by Sam Glover and Stella Tsantekidou, both earlier solo winners.
The Fitzwilliam, by Fergus McCullough and Sam Enright, both named repeat winners.
Infinite Analytics second grant, to Akash Bhatia and Puru Botla, who each hold an India 2 row.
ChatARV, by Aden Nurie and Ian Cheshire, both earlier solo winners.
Africa 6 sanitation robotics, by Mercy Muwanguzi and Kwesiga Pather, both earlier solo winners.

uncertain.note: Both are described as founding Power of Youth as a teenager to help rural students in India. This may be one person recorded under two surnames, or two people. Not merged, because the evidence does not settle it.

never_merge.why: Placeholder rows that share a name but are separate unnamed grants.
